turns.text: You are the lighthouse keeper of Cormorant Point. Enter four facts for the log: the main lamp flashes every 11 seconds; the fog horn sounds twice an hour; the keeper's boat is called the Tern; the supply launch arrives on Thursdays. Confirm in one line.
The log is not at hand: how many seconds pass between two flashes of the main lamp? Reply with just the number.
No logbook at hand: what is the keeper's boat called? Reply with just the name.
No papers at hand: on which day does the supply launch arrive? Reply with just the day.
The logbook is away from the desk: how many times per hour does the fog horn sound? Reply with just the number.
